text:
Leah Martin: Planning to deploy release 2026.3.1 in tonight's change window 23:00-01:00 PT. Placing code freeze at 22:00 PT. Main changes: runtime kernel bump (KV cache improvements) and a minor API contract change: /v1/generate will stop accepting top_k (deprecated) — SDKs must pin. Canary plan: 5% for first 10m, then ramp. No DB migrations. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/2026-3-1

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by Leah Martin for 2026.3.1 -> prod at 23:00 PT. Artifact: rwd-2026.3.1@sha256:abc123. Canary: 5%. Rollback target: rwd-2026.3.0.

Dmitri Petrov: Please pin runtime to `rwd-runtime@v4.12.0` for Dedicated nodes; kernel mismatch causes fallback and perf regressions.

Ashley Chen: Noted. I'll update SDK release notes and add a deprecation warning to the console. Marketing freeze confirmed — they will hold messaging until 22:30 PT.

Kevin Ortiz: Oncall coverage set: Kevin primary 23:00-01:00, Dmitri backup. Runbook attached: /playbooks/deploy-rollback. Abort criteria: latency p90 > 300ms for 3m or error rate spike > 1%.

Leah Martin: Can we gate the canary on the `api-compat` smoke test? Add it to the canary job.

deploy-bot: CI smoke `api-compat` passed on canary build before 23:00. Artifact integrity OK.

sre-bot: Temporary alerts added: api_err_rate > 1%, p95 latency > 400ms. Dashboards: /dashboards/2026-3-1. Pager escalation: if canary aborts, page #sre on-call.

Dmitri Petrov: Also: pin model weights to `v2.5-quant` on Dedicated to avoid OOMs on older drivers.

Ashley Chen: Release notes draft: https://docs.redwood/releases/2026-3-1. I will call out top_k deprecation and include migration snippet.

Leah Martin: Ack. All checks green. I'll post final go/no-go at 22:55 PT. :thumbsup:
